summary.text: Daniel Hawkins is a Republican who represents Kansas House District 100 in Sedgwick County and has served in the House since 2013.
He is the Speaker of the House and chairs the Legislative Coordinating Council.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Hawkins's occupation is insurance agent, and his spouse is Diane.

He also chairs the Interstate Cooperation Committee and is vice chair of the Calendar and Printing Committee, and has served on the 2024 Special Committees on Budget Process and Development and on Legislative Budget.
